title: After the leak of 30+ N-central exploits, N-able took its hosted systems offline worldwide and advises customers to keep their own servers offline for now
content_md:
After the leak of more than 30 N-central exploits, N-able shut down its hosted systems worldwide and advises customers to keep their own servers offline for the time being.

via Mastodon https://www.golem.de/news/able2shell-geleakte-n-central-exploits-gefaehrden-unzaehlige-unternehmen-2611-215026.html
